name: MaxInGaussian-pi-plans
description: Human-in-the-loop planning extension for the Pi coding agent. Turns rough change requests into versioned Markdown plans, stores them in a configurable artifact root, refines them through reviewer/criticizer subagents, and gates implementation behind tracked execution and explicit approval.
